picks.title: IATSE Appoints First Labor & Technology Intelligence Officer
picks.excerpt: IATSE has appointed Jillian Arnold to a new role focused on understanding emerging technologies and their impact on entertainment workers.
picks.rationale: Hollywood's largest crew union creates its first dedicated AI/technology officer, a concrete institutional step that will shape how AI terms reach below-the-line workers.

picks.title: Peter Chan Rules Out AI-Generated Content, Says Feature Films Will Survive the Rise of Vertical Dramas
picks.excerpt: Peter Chan says he won't use AI-generated content and that feature films will outlast vertical dramas, at the Singapore International Film Festival.
picks.rationale: A major Hong Kong producer-director rules out AI-generated content and ties it to the vertical-drama boom, where most AI microdramas are now being made.

picks.title: Lorem Ipsum Rap | F&C ai Lab
picks.excerpt: F&C's ai Lab releases 'Lorem Ipsum Rap', an AI-assisted motion piece exploring generative tools in a studio motion-design workflow.
picks.rationale: A new studio piece showing generative tools inside a real motion-design workflow, a hands-on reference for motion designers.

picks.title: The Concept Art Awards: Blind Judging by Peers and No AI Allowed
picks.excerpt: Co-founders Rachel Meinerding and Nicole Hendrix Herman explain why they built an awards show celebrating artists the industry rarely credits, and why this year's honorees Yoshitaka Amano and Eyvind Earle drew the most Lifetime Achievement votes; coming Saturday, October 24, at Lightbox Expo in Pasadena.
picks.rationale: A peer-judged concept art awards show with an explicit no-AI rule and named honorees (Amano, Earle), showing how craft communities are now writing AI bans into their own eligibility rules.
